field.keywordsPlaceholder: Type keyword, press Enter to add...
field.specifiedIdsHint: Enter post or video ID/URL, one per line or comma-separated
field.creatorIdsHint: Enter creator ID/URL, one per line or comma-separated
field.downloadMediaHint: Download cover and video (images for image posts). Supports xhs/dy/ks/bili/wb
field.stopConditionHint: Xiaohongshu search supports exhaustion mode. Other modes use a count limit. Errors and access restrictions stop with an error.
field.stopAtCount: Reach the limit, or run out of data earlier
field.stopWhenExhausted: Stop when there are no more posts
field.maxNotesHint: 1–1000000 per keyword/creator. Large jobs automatically slow down.
field.maxCommentsHint: 1–1000000; stops earlier when comments run out. Replies follow their separate switch.
field.saveFormatHint: For large jobs, prefer JSONL or SQLite to avoid rewriting the whole JSON file.
field.rateHint: One concurrent worker. Large jobs (10000 posts or estimated posts × comments), or exhaustion mode, use at least 5 seconds between requests and periodic rests. Per-request pacing applies to XHS; other platforms retain page/comment delays. Rate limits and verification stop requests; bans cannot be ruled out.

warning.cookieSlider: [Note] Cookie login is not recommended for Xiaohongshu and Douyin due to slider captcha
warning.xhsToken: [Important] Xiaohongshu URLs must contain xsec_token parameter, please copy the full URL from browser
